1, 2 & 3 Bedroom Apartments in Virginia Beach

1, 2 & 3 Bedroom Apartments in Virginia Beach

Saltmeadow Bay Apartments blends the thrill of coastal living with the serenity of home. You can choose from a variety of spacious interiors boasting stylish features and one, two, or three bedrooms. Our apartments in Virginia Beach, VA will charm from the start, with their chic details and alluring leisure spots. Explore our floor plans and claim the one you want!
Lease Cost Calculator. This Calculator is designed to help estimate the Move-In Cost (including General and Special Fees) and the Monthly Cost going forward of a lease. Please remember that the Move-In Cost and Monthly Cost will vary depending on the qualifications of the applicant, the price and amenities of the unit being rented, and the cost of any Special Fees that may apply to a specific unit. Additionally, the rent and the Standard and Special Fees and Fee ranges are accurate as currently displayed but may increase or decrease until a lease is signed.

Start a New Chapter in Our Virginia Beach Apartments

You’ll have all the space to engage in your activities, as even our smallest, one-bedroom layout covers 818 square feet. If you want to splurge on space, you may opt for our three-bedroom options that reach as much as 1,580 square feet. If you wish for something in between, our two-bedroom residences are the perfect fit as they range from 1,178 to 1,369 square feet. All our apartments for rent in Virginia Beach exude style and sophistication thanks to their brushed nickel fixtures and finishes, as well as the high ceilings, plush carpets, and hardwood-style floors. They also include washer/dryer sets, large closets, patios, and fireplaces, and depending on your choice, you may also have inspiring views and stainless-steel appliances.

After a fun day out in Virginia Beach, our apartments will welcome you with the same good vibes. Dive into the pool and soak up the sunshine in the courtyard, then enjoy some shade and homemade barbeque at the grilling pavilion. There’s also a business center for busy workdays, a modern gym for energizing workouts, and a resident clubhouse for evenings in great company.

If this is the life you’ve always wanted, it’s time to book a visit!
